description: deps-runner is dispatched against a target repo with open Dependabot PRs. The orchestrator must preflight the repo's devbox before spawning a Pylot worker, and the resulting worker_id must survive unchanged through every one of the six stage handoffs even though each subagent stage boots with an isolated context and no access to the orchestrator's bash state. The worker must be stopped as stage 06's first action, and no file under the skill directory may reference Gitpod, Ona, or a raw ENV_ID execution model.

messages.text: Run deps-runner against fellowship-dev/example-app — there are a handful of open Dependabot PRs piling up.

turns.setup: Stage 01 scans context for fellowship-dev/example-app. The repo has a devbox image registered.

expectedBehavior.description: Stage 01 runs `pylot devboxes project fellowship-dev/example-app` before ever spawning a worker. Only after that preflight confirms a devbox image does it run `pylot workers spawn` and record the resulting worker_id with devbox_ready: true in its handoff. If preflight had instead reported no devbox image, stage 01 must set devbox_ready: false and skip spawning entirely — never fabricate a worker_id.

turns.setup: Stage 04 boots as a fresh Task subagent with no memory of stage 01-03's bash variables — only the handoff.md files on disk.

expectedBehavior.description: Stage 04 reads worker_id verbatim from stage 03's handoff.md and re-states it unchanged in its own handoff for stage 05 to read. It must never spawn a second worker, never leave worker_id blank, and never ask the orchestrator to re-supply it out of band.

turns.setup: All candidate PRs have been processed (or the run was blocked partway through) and execution reaches stage 06.

expectedBehavior.description: Stage 06's first action, before any report file is written, is `pylot workers stop <worker_id> --mission <job_id> --force`. Only after the stop is confirmed (or explicitly recorded as `none — devbox unavailable, nothing spawned` when stage 01 set devbox_ready: false) does the stage write the local report file.

turns.setup: Every file under the deps-runner skill directory (SKILL.md, CONTEXT.md, all six stages/*/CONTEXT.md, shared/*) is statically scanned for legacy execution-environment references.

expectedBehavior.description: The scan returns zero matches. Every remote-execution step in the skill uses the Pylot worker idiom (`pylot workers prompt ... --wait --timeout N`, `pylot workers output`, `pylot workers view`, `pylot workers stop ... --force`) instead of `gitpod environment ssh $ENV_ID -- ...` or a `container` invocation argument.

failureShape.observedFailure: deps-runner's stage docs instructed the orchestrator to `gitpod environment ssh $ENV_ID -- "<cmd>"` and accepted a `container` invocation argument that Pylot's worker/devbox model has no equivalent for. Because Task subagents in stages 02-06 do not inherit the orchestrator's bash state, any environment identifier established in stage 01 was invisible to later stages unless explicitly re-threaded — and the old design never re-threaded it, nor did it ever preflight the target repo or stop anything in stage 06, so compute was either never correctly provisioned or leaked indefinitely.
failureShape.note: Must fail against pre-#2992 deps-runner content (gitpod ssh commands, container arg, no devbox preflight, no worker stop step) and pass once the Pylot worker/devbox lifecycle rewrite (spawn in 01, drive in 02-05, stop-first in 06) is live.
